sentences.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
sentences.zh: 如果不遵守安全规程，你可能会受伤。

sentences.en: Some were injured and others were killed in the accident.
sentences.zh: 事故中有人受了伤，还有人丧生。

sentences.en: He was injured in his left leg in the accident.

senses.zh: 损害，毁坏,伤害（名誉、自尊等）,（尤指事故中）伤害,伤害（感情，自尊心等）
